messages.subject: Saudi Executive Leadership | Government Relations, ESG & Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear People X Team,

Your Saudi executive-search focus on C-suite and senior leadership makes this a strong fit for my profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, and I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where institutional relationships, regulatory discipline and responsible development are central to performance.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
